name: strictConvexOn_eq_iff_lt
doc:
**严格凸性展开桥**：`StrictConvexOn ℝ s f` 与「`Convex ℝ s` 加上严格的中点不等式」
等价（即数学定义的逐项展开）。

这是 `StrictConvexOn` 的**定义体**本身（`Iff.rfl`），提供它是为了让下游证明
不必记住定义中的绑定结构即可 `rw [strictConvexOn_eq_iff_lt] at h`。
stmt:
theorem strictConvexOn_eq_iff_lt {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ s f ↔ Convex ℝ s ∧ ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → x ≠ y →
      ∀ ⦃a b : ℝ⦄, 0 < a → 0 < b → a + b = 1 →
        f (a • x + b • y) < a • f x + b • f y
proof: Iff.rfl

name: strictConvexOn_imp_convexOn
doc:
**严格凸 ⟹ 凸**：`StrictConvexOn ℝ s f → ConvexOn ℝ s f`。

证明：逐点比较 `ConvexOn` 的弱不等式与 `StrictConvexOn` 的强不等式；
`x = y` 的退化情形用 `a • x + b • x = (a + b) • x = x` 化去（`add_smul` + `hab`），
此时两侧同为 `f x`。
stmt:
theorem strictConvexOn_imp_convexOn {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ s f) : ConvexOn ℝ s f
proof:
by
                                                                        
                                         
  obtain ⟨hconv, hstrict⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨hconv, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
                                                                         
                                                       
                                         
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with ha0 | ha0
  ·                                         
    subst ha0
    have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
    subst hb1
    simp
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with hb0 | hb0
  ·                                         
    subst hb0
    have ha1 : a = 1 := by linarith
    subst ha1
    simp
  ·                          
    have ha' : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
    have hb' : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (Ne.symm hb0)
    rcases eq_or_ne x y with rfl | hne
    · have h1 : a • x + b • x = x := by rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
      have h2 : a • f x + b • f x = f x := by rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
      rw [h1, h2]
    · exact le_of_lt (hstrict hx hy hne ha' hb' hab)

name: eq_of_strictConvexOn_combo_eq
doc:
**核心引擎（严格凸版）**：严格凸函数在两点加权组合处取等，则两点相等。

证明：`by_contra` 得 `x ≠ y`，由 `hf.2` 得严格 `<`，与等号假设矛盾
（`lt_irrefl`）。

这是全库「某不等式取等 ⟹ 结构相等」的公共引擎的最一般形式；
`log_combo_eq_iff` / `mulLog_combo_eq_iff` 都是它的实例。
stmt:
theorem eq_of_strictConvexOn_combo_eq {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ s f) {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1)
    (heq : f (a • x + b • y) = a • f x + b • f y) : x = y
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨-, hstrict⟩ := hf
  by_contra hne
  have hlt := hstrict (x := x) (y := y) (a := a) (b := b) hx hy hne ha hb hab
  rw [heq] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

name: eq_of_strictConcaveOn_combo_eq
doc:
**核心引擎（严格凹版）**：严格凹函数在两点加权组合处取等，则两点相等。

与 `eq_of_strictConvexOn_combo_eq` 对偶（严格 `<` 的方向相反，写法同形）。
stmt:
theorem eq_of_strictConcaveOn_combo_eq {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : StrictConcaveOn ℝ s f) {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1)
    (heq : a • f x + b • f y = f (a • x + b • y)) : x = y
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨-, hstrict⟩ := hf
  by_contra hne
  have hlt := hstrict (x := x) (y := y) (a := a) (b := b) hx hy hne ha hb hab
  rw [heq] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

name: eq_of_strictConvexOn_sum_eq
doc:
**Jensen 等号引擎（严格凸版）**：`f` 在 `s` 上严格凸、权重 `w` 在非空 `t` 上严格正
且 `Σ_{i∈t} w i = 1`、`p i ∈ s` 时，

`f (Σ_{i∈t} w i • p i) = Σ_{i∈t} w i • f (p i)  ⟹  ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, p i = p j`。

证明：走 mathlib `StrictConvexOn.map_sum_eq_iff`（它给出
`p j = Σ i, w i • p i`），再对 `i, j` 同时代换。
参数 `ht : t.Nonempty` 由调用方提供以保证「非空权重归一」的语义完整性
（本证明本身不消耗它）。
stmt:
theorem eq_of_strictConvexOn_sum_eq {ι : Type*} {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ s f) {t : Finset ι} (ht : t.Nonempty) (w p : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 < w i) (h1 : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s)
    (heq : f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)) :
    ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, p i = p j
proof:
by
                                                          
  have h := (hf.map_sum_eq_iff (t := t) hw h1 hmem).mp heq
  intro i hi j hj
  rw [h i hi, h j hj]

name: log_eq_sub_one_iff_of_pos
doc:
**`log z = z − 1` 的等号刻画**：`0 < z` ⟹ `Real.log z = z − 1 ⟺ z = 1`。

证明：`z ≠ 1` 时 `Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos` 给出严格 `<`，与等号矛盾；
`z = 1` 时两边同为 `0`。这是 `log z ≤ z − 1` 的等号情形，
在 `log_combo_eq_iff` 中把「两项非正且和为 0」收紧为「`x/m = 1`」。
stmt:
lemma log_eq_sub_one_iff_of_pos {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    Real.log z = z - 1 ↔ z = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hz1
    have hlt := Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos hz hz1
    linarith
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: log_combo_eq_iff
doc:
**`Real.log` 的严格凹等号情形**（初等证法）：

`0 < a`、`0 < b`、`a + b = 1`、`0 < x`、`0 < y` ⟹

`a·log x + b·log y = log(a·x + b·y)  ⟺  x = y`。

证明：令 `m = a·x + b·y > 0`。`log x = log(x/m) + log m`（`x = (x/m)·m`），
故等号等价于 `a·log(x/m) + b·log(y/m) = 0`。由 `Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos` 逐项乘正权，
左端 `≤ a·(x/m − 1) + b·(y/m − 1) = (a·(x/m) + b·(y/m)) − (a + b) = 1 − 1 = 0`；
又两块 `a·(log(x/m) − (x/m − 1)) ≤ 0`、`b·(log(y/m) − (y/m − 1)) ≤ 0` 且和为 0，
故各自为 0，从而 `log(x/m) = x/m − 1`，用 `log_eq_sub_one_iff_of_pos` 得 `x/m = 1`，
同理 `y/m = 1`，所以 `x = m = y`。

**`诚实`**：本证明**不**依赖 `strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi` 的命名空间，故对 mathlib
版本迁移稳健（引擎 4 `eq_of_strictConcaveOn_combo_eq` 仍独立交付）。
stmt:
theorem log_combo_eq_iff {a b x y : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    a * Real.log x + b * Real.log y = Real.log (a * x + b * y) ↔ x = y
proof:
by
  set m : ℝ := a * x + b * y with hm
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    rw [hm]
    positivity
  have hxlog : Real.log x = Real.log (x / m) + Real.log m := by
    have hsplit : x = (x / m) * m := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ x (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos hx hmpos)) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
  have hylog : Real.log y = Real.log (y / m) + Real.log m := by
    have hsplit : y = (y / m) * m := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ y (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos hy hmpos)) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
  have hsum : a * (x / m) + b * (y / m) = 1 := by
    have h1 : a * (x / m) + b * (y / m) = (a * x + b * y) / m := by ring
    rw [h1, ← hm, div_self (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
                                                  
  have key : a * Real.log x + b * Real.log y - Real.log m
      = a * Real.log (x / m) + b * Real.log (y / m) := by
    rw [hxlog, hylog]
    have hexp : a * (Real.log (x / m) + Real.log m)
          + b * (Real.log (y / m) + Real.log m) - Real.log m
        = (a * Real.log (x / m) + b * Real.log (y / m)) + (a + b - 1) * Real.log m := by
      ring
    rw [hexp, hab]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hzero : a * Real.log (x / m) + b * Real.log (y / m) = 0 := by
      have hk := key
      rw [h] at hk
                                                           
                                                   
      rw [sub_self] at hk
      exact hk.symm

name: mulLog_combo_eq_iff
doc:
**`x ↦ x·log x` 的严格凸等号情形**：

`0 < a`、`0 < b`、`a + b = 1`、`0 ≤ x`、`0 ≤ y` ⟹

`(a·x + b·y)·log(a·x + b·y) = a·(x·log x) + b·(y·log y)  ⟺  x = y`。

证明：由 mathlib `Real.strictConvexOn_mul_log`（断言 `fun z ↦ z·log z` 在 `Set.Ici 0`
上严格凸，含端点 `0`，依赖约定 `Real.log 0 = 0`）配合核心引擎
`eq_of_strictConvexOn_combo_eq`；`Set.Ici 0` 的成员由 `Set.mem_Ici.mpr` 给出。

**`标注`**：端点 `0` 处使用 Lean/`Real.log` 的连续延拓约定 `log 0 = 0`，
故 `0·log 0 = 0` 被正确覆盖。
stmt:
theorem mulLog_combo_eq_iff {a b x y : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    (a * x + b * y) * Real.log (a * x + b * y)
      = a * (x * Real.log x) + b * (y * Real.log y) ↔ x = y
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : (fun z : ℝ => z * Real.log z) (a • x + b • y)
        = a • (fun z : ℝ => z * Real.log z) x + b • (fun z : ℝ => z * Real.log z) y := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using h
    exact eq_of_strictConvexOn_combo_eq Real.strictConvexOn_mul_log
      (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hx) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hy) ha hb hab h'
  ·                                                                         
                      
    rintro rfl
    have h1 : a * x + b * x = x := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : a * (x * Real.log x) + b * (x * Real.log x) = x * Real.log x := by
      rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    rw [h2]

name: strictMono_injective
doc:
**严格单调 ⟹ 单射**：`StrictMono f → Function.Injective f`。

mathlib 的 `StrictMono.injective` 的薄封装（统一名，避免各文件重复定义同义引理）。
stmt:
theorem strictMono_injective {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β] {f : α → β}
    (hf : StrictMono f) : Function.Injective f
proof: hf.injective

name: strictAnti_injective

**严格单调递减 ⟹ 单射**：`StrictAnti f → Function.Injective f`。

mathlib 的 `StrictAnti.injective` 的薄封装。
stmt:
theorem strictAnti_injective {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β] {f : α → β}

hf.injective

end Lattice

name: SlaterCondition
doc: **Slater 条件**：存在严格可行点 x（∀i, g_i(x) < 0）。
stmt: def SlaterCondition (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∃ x : ℝ, ∀ i, g i x < 0

name: slater_implies_feasible
doc: Slater 条件 ⟹ 可行点存在。
stmt:
theorem slater_implies_feasible (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (h : SlaterCondition g) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, ∀ i, g i x ≤ 0
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
  exact ⟨x, fun i => le_of_lt (hx i)⟩

name: slater_sum_strictly_negative
doc:
**Slater 点的严格负性和**：x̄ 严格可行、λ ≥ 0 且某分量 λ_{i₀} > 0
⟹ Σ_i λ_i g_i(x̄) < 0（逐项 ≤ 0，在 i₀ 处严格负）。
stmt:
theorem slater_sum_strictly_negative (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hslater : ∀ i, g i x < 0) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (i₀ : Fin n) (hi₀ : 0 < lam i₀) :
    ∑ i, lam i * g i x < 0
proof:
by
  have hnonpos : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), lam i * g i x ≤ (0 : ℝ) :=
    fun i _ => mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hlam i) (le_of_lt (hslater i))
  have hstrict : ∃ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), lam i * g i x < (0 : ℝ) :=
    ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_univ i₀, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hi₀ (hslater i₀)⟩
  have := Finset.sum_lt_sum hnonpos hstrict
  simpa using this

name: slater_lagrangian_lt
doc: **Slater 点处拉格朗日函数严格低于目标**：非零乘子在严格可行点必使 L(x̄,λ) < f(x̄)。
stmt:
theorem slater_lagrangian_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hslater : ∀ i, g i x < 0) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (i₀ : Fin n) (hi₀ : 0 < lam i₀) :
    Lagrangian f g x lam < f x
proof:
by
  have hsum := slater_sum_strictly_negative g x lam hslater hlam i₀ hi₀
  unfold Lagrangian
  linarith

name: zero_gap_iff_complementary_slackness
doc:
**零间隙的完整刻画（有限支撑）**：x ∈ s、λ ≥ 0、x 可行时，
    dualValue(λ) = f(x)  ⟺  (∀i, λ_i g_i(x) = 0) 且 x 在 s 上极小化 L(·,λ)。

说明：两个条件缺一不可。仅有互补松弛只给出 L(x,λ) = f(x) ≥ dualValue(λ)
（因 dualValue 是 inf），要取等必须再要求 L(x,λ) = dualValue(λ)，即 x 极小化 L。
stmt:
theorem zero_gap_iff_complementary_slackness (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x : ℝ) (hxs : x ∈ s) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hfeas : ∀ i, g i x ≤ 0) :
    dualValue f g s hs lam = f x ↔
      ((∀ i, lam i * g i x = 0) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ s, Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ Lagrangian f g y lam)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hlow : Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ f x := lagrangian_lower_bound f g x lam hlam hfeas
    have hinf : dualValue f g s hs lam ≤ Lagrangian f g x lam := by
      simp only [dualValue]
      exact Finset.inf'_le (s := s) (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hxs
    have hL : Lagrangian f g x lam = f x :=
      le_antisymm hlow (by rw [← h]; exact hinf)
    have hsum : ∑ i, lam i * g i x = 0 := by
      have hh := hL
      unfold Lagrangian at hh
      linarith
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos
        (fun i _ => mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hlam i) (hfeas i))).mp hsum i
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    · rw [hL, ← h]
      simp only [dualValue]
      exact Finset.inf'_le (s := s) (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hy
  · rintro ⟨hcs, hmin⟩
    have hsum : ∑ i, lam i * g i x = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => hcs i
    have hL : Lagrangian f g x lam = f x := by
      unfold Lagrangian
      rw [hsum]
      ring
    have hinf : dualValue f g s hs lam ≤ Lagrangian f g x lam := by
      simp only [dualValue]
      exact Finset.inf'_le (s := s) (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hxs
    have hle : Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ dualValue f g s hs lam := by
      simp only [dualValue]
      exact Finset.le_inf' hs (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hmin
    rw [← hL]
    exact le_antisymm hinf hle

name: zero_gap_implies_complementary_slackness
doc: 零间隙 ⟹ 互补松弛（定理 4 的前向投影）。
stmt:
theorem zero_gap_implies_complementary_slackness (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x : ℝ) (hxs : x ∈ s) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hfeas : ∀ i, g i x ≤ 0)
    (hgap : dualValue f g s hs lam = f x) :
    ∀ i, lam i * g i x = 0
proof: ((zero_gap_iff_complementary_slackness f g s hs x hxs lam hlam hfeas).mp hgap).1

name: strong_duality_under_compactness
doc:
**紧致支撑下的强对偶（间隙公式）**：有限（紧致）支撑 s 上，若 x ∈ s 极小化 L(·,λ)，
则对偶 inf **可达**且间隙有精确表达式

    dualValue(λ) = f(x) + Σ_i λ_i g_i(x)，

即 f(x) − dualValue(λ) = −Σ_i λ_i g_i(x)。配合 λ ≥ 0、x 可行（弱对偶）即得非负间隙；
零间隙当且仅当互补松弛项为零。

证明：`Finset.inf'_le` 给出 dualValue ≤ L(x,λ)，`Finset.le_inf'` 配合极小性给出
L(x,λ) ≤ dualValue，两边夹紧后展开 Lagrangian 的定义。
stmt:
theorem strong_duality_under_compactness (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x : ℝ) (hxs : x ∈ s) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmin : ∀ y ∈ s, Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ Lagrangian f g y lam) :
    dualValue f g s hs lam = f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x
proof:
by
  have hinf : dualValue f g s hs lam ≤ Lagrangian f g x lam := by
    simp only [dualValue]
    exact Finset.inf'_le (s := s) (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hxs
  have hle : Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ dualValue f g s hs lam := by
    simp only [dualValue]
    exact Finset.le_inf' hs (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hmin
  have hL : dualValue f g s hs lam = Lagrangian f g x lam := le_antisymm hinf hle
  rw [hL, Lagrangian]

name: dual_attainment
doc:
**对偶最优可达**：零间隙（f(x) ≤ dualValue(λ)）⟹ 对偶值等于原值、互补松弛成立、
且 x 在 s 上极小化 L(·,λ)——λ 即（有限支撑意义下的）最优乘子。
stmt:
theorem dual_attainment (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (x : ℝ) (hxs : x ∈ s) (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i)
    (hfeas : ∀ i, g i x ≤ 0) (hgap : f x ≤ dualValue f g s hs lam) :
    dualValue f g s hs lam = f x ∧ (∀ i, lam i * g i x = 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ s, Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ Lagrangian f g y lam
proof:
by
  have hlow : Lagrangian f g x lam ≤ f x := lagrangian_lower_bound f g x lam hlam hfeas
  have hinf : dualValue f g s hs lam ≤ Lagrangian f g x lam := by
    simp only [dualValue]
    exact Finset.inf'_le (s := s) (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hxs
  have hL : Lagrangian f g x lam = f x := le_antisymm hlow (le_trans hgap hinf)
  have hvaleq : dualValue f g s hs lam = f x := le_antisymm (le_trans hinf (le_of_eq hL)) hgap
  have hsum : ∑ i, lam i * g i x = 0 := by
    have hh := hL
    unfold Lagrangian at hh
    linarith
  refine ⟨hvaleq, fun i => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos
      (fun i _ => mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hlam i) (hfeas i))).mp hsum i
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · rw [hL, ← hvaleq]
    simp only [dualValue]
    exact Finset.inf'_le (s := s) (fun x' => Lagrangian f g x' lam) hy

name: slater_implies_strong_duality
doc:
**Slater 边界情形（强对偶 + λ = 0）**：若证书点 x 本身是 **Slater 点**
（∀i, g_i(x) < 0）、λ ≥ 0、x 可行且在该点零间隙成立（f(x) ≤ dualValue(λ)），
则 **λ = 0**，且 dualValue(λ) = f(x)。

意义：Slater 点位于可行域**内部**，零间隙蕴含的互补松弛 λ_i g_i(x) = 0 与
g_i(x) < 0 迫使每个 λ_i = 0——乘子只编码**边界**处的约束活性。这是完整强对偶定理中
「Slater ⟹ 最优乘子存在」一侧所能达到的边界结论。
stmt:
theorem slater_implies_strong_duality (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x : ℝ) (hxs : x ∈ s) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hslater : ∀ i, g i x < 0) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hfeas : ∀ i, g i x ≤ 0)
    (hgap : f x ≤ dualValue f g s hs lam) :
    lam = 0 ∧ dualValue f g s hs lam = f x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hvaleq, hcs, -⟩ := dual_attainment f g s hs x hxs lam hlam hfeas hgap
  refine ⟨?_, hvaleq⟩
  funext i
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hcs i)).resolve_right (ne_of_lt (hslater i))

name: slater_multiplier_vanishes
doc: Slater 点的**乘子消失**（定理 7 的投影）。
stmt:
theorem slater_multiplier_vanishes (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x : ℝ) (hxs : x ∈ s) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hslater : ∀ i, g i x < 0) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hfeas : ∀ i, g i x ≤ 0)
    (hgap : f x ≤ dualValue f g s hs lam) :
    lam = 0
proof: (slater_implies_strong_duality f g s hs x hxs lam hslater hlam hfeas hgap).1

name: slaterCounterF
doc: 反例的目标函数：f(1) = −100，其余点取 0（故 f(−1) = 0）。
stmt: def slaterCounterF (x : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: if x = 1 then -100 else 0

name: slaterCounterG
doc: 反例的约束族（单约束 g(x) = x ≤ 0）。
stmt: def slaterCounterG : Fin 1 → ℝ → ℝ
proof: fun _ x => x

name: slaterCounterSupport
doc: 反例的有限支撑 {−1, 1}。
stmt: def slaterCounterSupport : Finset ℝ

name: slaterCounterSupport_nonempty
doc: 支撑非空。
stmt: theorem slaterCounterSupport_nonempty : slaterCounterSupport.Nonempty
proof: ⟨-1, by simp [slaterCounterSupport]⟩

name: slaterCounterF_neg_one
stmt: theorem slaterCounterF_neg_one : slaterCounterF (-1) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold slaterCounterF
  rw [if_neg (by norm_num : ¬((-1 : ℝ) = 1))]

name: slaterCounterF_one
stmt: theorem slaterCounterF_one : slaterCounterF 1 = -100
proof:
by
  unfold slaterCounterF
  rw [if_pos rfl]

name: slaterCounter_lagrangian
doc: 反例中 L(y, λ) = f(y) + λ₀·y。
stmt:
theorem slaterCounter_lagrangian (lam : Fin 1 → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    Lagrangian slaterCounterF slaterCounterG y lam = slaterCounterF y + lam 0 * y
proof:
by
  simp [Lagrangian, slaterCounterG, Fin.sum_univ_one]

name: slater_not_sufficient_discrete
doc:
**反例（诚实边界）**：Slater 条件在**离散支撑**下不足以保证强对偶。

支撑 s = {−1, 1}、约束 g(x) = x ≤ 0（Slater 点 x̄ = −1：g(x̄) = −1 < 0）、
f(−1) = 0、f(1) = −100。此时：
  · −1 是支撑内**唯一**可行点（故原问题最优值 = f(−1) = 0）；
  · 对任意 λ ≥ 0，dualValue(λ) = min(−λ, −100 + λ) ≤ −50；
  · 取 λ = 50 时 dualValue = −50（且 −50 是全局最大值）。
所以间隙恒 ≥ 50 > 0——**Slater 条件本身不充分**，强对偶还需可行集的凸性/连续性
（连续凸情形下 Slater 保证内点，支撑的凸包才可能承载分离定理）。
stmt:
theorem slater_not_sufficient_discrete :
    (∀ i : Fin 1, slaterCounterG i (-1) < 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ slaterCounterSupport, (∀ i, slaterCounterG i x ≤ 0) → x = -1) ∧
    (∀ lam : Fin 1 → ℝ, 0 ≤ lam 0 →
      dualValue slaterCounterF slaterCounterG slaterCounterSupport
        slaterCounterSupport_nonempty lam ≤ -50) ∧
    (∃ lam : Fin 1 → ℝ, 0 ≤ lam 0 ∧
      dualValue slaterCounterF slaterCounterG slaterCounterSupport
        slaterCounterSupport_nonempty lam = -50) ∧
    (∀ lam : Fin 1 → ℝ, 0 ≤ lam 0 →
      dualValue slaterCounterF slaterCounterG slaterCounterSupport
        slaterCounterSupport_nonempty lam < slaterCounterF (-1))
proof:
by
  have hSlater : ∀ i : Fin 1, slaterCounterG i (-1) < 0 := by
    intro i; norm_num [slaterCounterG]
  have hUniq : ∀ x ∈ slaterCounterSupport, (∀ i, slaterCounterG i x ≤ 0) → x = -1 := by
    intro x hx hfeas
    simp only [slaterCounterSupport, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by simpa [slaterCounterG] using hfeas 0
      exact absurd h1 (by norm_num)
  have hinf_le : ∀ (lam : Fin 1 → ℝ) (y : ℝ), y ∈ slaterCounterSupport →
      dualValue slaterCounterF slaterCounterG slaterCounterSupport
        slaterCounterSupport_nonempty lam
        ≤ Lagrangian slaterCounterF slaterCounterG y lam := by
    intro lam y hy
    simp only [dualValue]
    exact Finset.inf'_le (s := slaterCounterSupport)
      (fun x' => Lagrangian slaterCounterF slaterCounterG x' lam) hy
  have hBound : ∀ lam : Fin 1 → ℝ, 0 ≤ lam 0 →
      dualValue slaterCounterF slaterCounterG slaterCounterSupport
        slaterCounterSupport_nonempty lam ≤ -50 := by
    intro lam hlam
    have h1 := hinf_le lam (-1) (by simp [slaterCounterSupport])
    have h2 := hinf_le lam 1 (by simp [slaterCounterSupport])
    simp only [slaterCounter_lagrangian, slaterCounterF_neg_one, slaterCounterF_one] at h1 h2
    linarith
  have hAttain : ∃ lam : Fin 1 → ℝ, 0 ≤ lam 0 ∧
      dualValue slaterCounterF slaterCounterG slaterCounterSupport
        slaterCounterSupport_nonempty lam = -50 := by
    have h50 : Lagrangian slaterCounterF slaterCounterG
